audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart shipped Galio winning levels 2 through First item while every whys[] row says the stage favours Yorick, and the packet chart reads Yorick/Skill/Skill/Yorick/Yorick/Yorick/Yorick at a 53.28% win rate over 1721 games.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] are the same row; both disagreed with the packet and with the prose beside them.
audit.corrected: Chart set to the packet: Yorick, Skill, Skill, Yorick, Yorick, Yorick, Yorick, proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Spike rows already track Dark Procession coming online at 3-5, level 6 Maiden, first item, and the two-item split window.
audit.corrected: Kept, with Justice Punch's 11s rank-1 cooldown added where the advice needed a number. Mirror confirms Dark Procession 20s rank 1, Mourning Mist 12s, Last Rites 6s, Eulogy of the Isles 160s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text calls Galio's engage an "E taunt-dash" in three places. Justice Punch (E) is the 650-range dash and knockup; the taunt is Shield of Durand (W).
audit.why: Slots were conflated, and the decisive interaction was never stated: Dark Procession is terrain, and Justice Punch halts on terrain, so the cage blocks the dash itself rather than only the retreat.
audit.corrected: Named the slots correctly and stated the terrain stop. Also recorded Colossal Smash (P) as an auto-attack reset whose wind-up is the tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the text mentioned Galio's passive proc as a burst tell.
audit.why: Galio's combo opens with the Colossal Smash reset, so the wind-up precedes the ability.
audit.corrected: Added to breakdown.early via the content early paragraph.

edits.before: E mark plus the first ghoul wave starts real trades. Only take the trade when Galio's Justice Punch is down.
edits.after: Mourning Mist plus the first ghoul starts real trades. Take it only when Justice Punch is spent — 11s at rank 1.

edits.before: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Justice Punch is a 650-range dash and knockup, 11s at rank 1. Commit only once it is spent or baited.

edits.before: W-cage when Justice Punch is down
edits.after: Cage the ground he punches through

edits.before: After Divine Sunderer your ghoul-backed all-ins beat his tanky mage stats, and if he E-taunt-dashes in you cage him with W and win the flip.
edits.after: After Divine Sunderer your ghoul-backed all-ins beat his tanky mage stats, and Justice Punch stops dead on Dark Procession — cage the lane he charges through and the knockup never lands.

edits.before: E taunt-dash into a favourable trade
edits.after: Justice Punch into a Durand taunt

edits.before: From 3 you cage him with W Dark Procession, E-slow him, and free-hit him where he can't land the back half of his Q. Levels 4-6 you out-shove with ghouls and Maiden and threaten his tower; his R is a roam/peel tool, so when he's tempted to ult another lane you punish the wave and take plates. Watch his E taunt-dash — bait it, then cage him and win the return trade. This whole stretch is a shove-and-pressure clinic in your favour.
edits.after: From 3 you cage him with W Dark Procession, E-slow him, and free-hit him where he can't land the back half of his Q. Levels 4-6 you out-shove with ghouls and Maiden and threaten his tower; his R is a roam/peel tool, so when he's tempted to ult another lane you punish the wave and take plates. Justice Punch halts on terrain, so drop the cage on his step-up and the knockup never arrives — the taunt is Shield of Durand, a separate 275-range button. This stretch is a shove-and-pressure clinic in your favour.

edits.before: Level 1 is yours — Galio is a weak early laner who wants to poke with Q Winds of War and stall to scale, and you can walk up behind minions, E Mourning Mist, and Q him before his shield sustain matters. Deny him free Q pokes and keep the wave moving so he can't farm comfortably. Your early ghoul pressure and auto damage simply out-trade his level-1 kit.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours — Galio is a weak early laner who wants to poke with Q Winds of War and stall to scale, and you can walk up behind minions, E Mourning Mist, and Q him before his shield sustain matters. Deny him free Q pokes and keep the wave moving so he can't farm comfortably. His combo opens with the Colossal Smash reset, so the auto wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast.
